_comment: claude-dsv4f shim configuration. Rates are USD per 1,000,000 tokens.
_fastModelNote: modelMapper() rewrites claude-3-5-haiku* (compaction, subagent dispatch, window-topic detection) to this sentinel so resolveModel() slots it as background (effort:none) instead of falling through to `model` at main-slot effort:high — was previously ~25-50x the intended cost for that traffic class.

effort._measuredEnum: MEASURED 2026-08-06 from a live 400: low|medium|high|xhigh|ultra|max. There is NO none — thinking is disabled via thinking:{type:disabled} instead. `ultra` is undocumented.
effort._measuredLadder: MEASURED 2026-08-06, hard problem, max_tokens=384000, no truncation: ultra=94857 chars thinking / 30911 out / 282s; max=128573 / 39136 / 391s. Non-overlapping ranges. max = +35% reasoning for +39% latency.
effort._autoSemantics: MEASURED: Claude Code always sends an effort level, so there is no absent state. autoLevel (high) is treated as no-preference and may be escalated by the heuristic; any other level the user picks is honoured verbatim. ultrathink overrides both.

peakSurcharge._comment: Announced 2x peak pricing, NOT yet in effect as of 2026-08-06. Windows are UTC (09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00 Beijing = UTC+8). Enable only when DeepSeek announces activation; --reconcile will warn if drawdown suggests it went live.

cap._comment: Rolling UTC day. Enforced on the conservative cost estimate. Raise with: dsv4f-cap N

balance._comment: GET /user/balance is an account endpoint: no tokens, no inference cost. Polling is activity-driven anyway — a sample taken once work quiesces brackets that work cleanly, which is what --reconcile needs.

vision._comment: Images are unsupported on DeepSeek Anthropic endpoint. The shim swaps each image for a text description from a vision model so DeepSeek keeps doing all coding/reasoning. Descriptions are cached by image hash: without that, resending a conversation would re-describe the same screenshot every turn AND mutate the prompt prefix, forfeiting DeepSeek 50x cache-hit discount.
vision._cacheSweepNote: Vision descriptions are cached forever otherwise. A daily sweep deletes entries older than cacheMaxAgeDays, then LRU-evicts down to cacheMaxEntries if still over. 0 disables either check.
vision.benchmark: 96.3% on real-image suite (8/9 on degraded-photo OCR, only model of 39 to read the handwritten phone number), 100% on UI screenshots, spotted inverted image; ~$0.38/100 screenshots, 14.0s avg. Runner-up google/gemini-2.0-flash-001: 92.6%, 7/9, ~$0.108/100, 18.8s (2026-08-06)
vision._promptNote: Descriptions are deliberately task-agnostic: the cache is keyed on the image alone, so a description steered by one question would be wrongly replayed for later, different questions about the same image.
vision._capNote: Enforced client-side from the ledger: DeepInfra exposes no balance or usage endpoint (every billing path 404s, /v1/me carries no billing fields), so the local ledger is the only record. Cached images are always served even past the cap, since replaying a cached description costs nothing.
